_comment: Epic 6 (p. 63): client and country-specific branding. Hot-reloadable - the API
reads this file per request, so a brand change needs no rebuild or deploy (NFR-45).
Resolution order is default -> client -> country. Each layer only overrides the
keys it names, so a country entry that needs a different timezone does not have to
Only these presentation tokens are overridable on purpose. Status, semantic and
text colours are NOT brandable: a client cannot repaint 'Closed' green or lower the
contrast of body text below the WCAG 2.2 AA floor the design system guarantees.
